_about: Sources and battle-only forms the game data scan does not find on its own, each verified in the untouched Chinese v4.0.3 ROM (2026-10-05; evidence in work/notes/availability_audit.md). "how" replaces the generated "how to get it" text, "battle" marks a form seen only in battle, "evoNote" adds a note to the evolution section, "note" explains an entry with no confirmed source, "evoBlocked" marks an evolution (by target id) as not possible with a reason. "fixedBy" names a code fix (work/patches/<id>) that removes the hack bug the entry describes: when the documented ROM carries it, only the entry's "withFix" fields apply (gen_docs.reviewed).

entries.name: Petilil
entries.evoNote: Leveling up while holding a Black Belt by day doesn't evolve it into Hisuian Lilligant: because of an error in the hack it stays a Petilil (the game even says "Petilil evolved into Petilil" and uses up the Black Belt). A Sun Stone then turns that Petilil into Hisuian Lilligant instead of Lilligant. Tested in an emulator.

evoBlocked.1361: because of an error in the hack it stays a Petilil (see below)

entries.name: Darumaka
entries.evoNote: Darumaka caught in Ice Path look like ordinary Darumaka but evolve into Darmanitan that remain in Zen Mode outside battle.

entries.name: Rockruff
entries.evoNote: Lycanroc’s form depends on when Rockruff evolves: Dusk Form at 17:00–19:59, Midnight Form at 20:00–03:59, otherwise Midday Form.

entries.name: Lycanroc
entries.evoNote: Evolving Rockruff in the evening gives Dusk Form, at night Midnight Form, otherwise Midday Form.

entries.name: Hisuian Lilligant
entries.how: use a Sun Stone on a Petilil that leveled up by day while holding a Black Belt (tested in an emulator)
entries.evoNote: Leveling up a Petilil by day while it holds a Black Belt doesn't give Hisuian Lilligant, although the evolution data says so: because of an error in the hack it stays a Petilil, and a Sun Stone then turns it into Hisuian Lilligant. Tested in an emulator.
